values.meaning: bonus magic damage dealt by Ziggs's next empowered basic attack
values.quote: {{as|{{pp|16+4*x for 6; then +8*x for 6; then +12*x for 8|formula = 16 + 4 per level up to 6, then + 8 per level up to 12, then + 12 per level up to 18}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

values.meaning: cooldown reduction to Short Fuse granted when Ziggs casts an ability
values.quote: {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 6 for 3|1 to 13}} seconds whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an {{tip|ability}}

mechanics.claim: Short Fuse's internal cooldown begins ticking when Ziggs attacks (not when it becomes available again), and it fires whenever the cooldown is up on his next basic attack.
If the empowered attack misses due to a blind, Short Fuse still goes on cooldown without dealing its bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Short Fuse'' will go on cooldown but not deal any damage if the attack misses due to {{tip|blind}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack's bonus damage is increased by 75% specifically against structures, which does not apply to an enemy-champion dummy target.
The cooldown reduction from casting an ability is granted at the moment the ability begins its cast time, not on impact or on cooldown completion.
mechanics.quote: The cooldown reduction is granted at the start of the abilities' cast time.
